newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banacci to repatriate $70 mln for capital.
newsitem.headline: Banacci to repatriate $70 mln for capital.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banamex-Accival (Banacci) on Thursday said it will repatriate some $70 million from its London subsidiary as part of its commitments to recapitalize its bank, Banamex.

"It intends to repatriate to Mexico, during the first half of the current year, approximately $70 million in capital from Banamex's wholly owned London-based subsidiary, Banamex Investment Bank PLC, and to surrender its subsidiary's banking license," the banking group said in a statement.
It said part of the repatriation was also to reorganize its investment banking activities.

Banamex remained committed to the London market, it said, and would conitnue to provide commercial banking facilities through its London branch and would also continue to conduct its Latin American securities activities through its SFA regulated subsidiary.

Banacci needs to raise Banamex's capital by four billion pesos this year, after selling eight billion pesos of past-due loans, net of reserves, to the government's Bank Insurance Fund (Fobaproa) in late December.
